scope: offline, source-repaired P8u Meta target/query evaluation; no live, admission, execution, or exchange mutation
lineage_supersedes: none; this is a target/query-only predecessor to the immutable expanded-base full-1400 CMI contract
lineage_note: The only source difference from v2 is the use of the sealed, source-repaired F72 target-free panels for the F72 target/query screen. Full-1400 CMI selection remains exclusively bound to v2 and its expanded-base panels.

model.fixed_iterations_note: The target/query screen uses a common frozen fit. Causal early-stop and HPO, if justified, are downstream of target selection.

magnitude.definition: strict-prequential rich-policy-net residual against a train-only Base-rank-to-policy-EV isotonic anchor; ordinalized into seven train-only quantile grades

under.definition: unexpected favorable path: policy residual clears the declared threshold and the resolved path reached the frozen 0.5-ATR trailing-profit activation

over.definition: unexpected adverse path: policy residual breaches the declared negative threshold and the canonical policy exits through stop-loss or fast-adverse protection

selection.final_authority: A candidate must improve the strict Meta-to-MC1 constrained portfolio. This stage alone cannot promote a Meta head.

causality.feature_inputs: base target-free scores/ranks and point-in-time causal features only
causality.labels: policy and path outcomes join only after target-free input identity is fixed; training labels must be available before the fold reserve
causality.train_residual: expanding 14-day Base-to-EV anchors use only earlier fully resolved policy labels
causality.held_score: held target-free score receipt is persisted before any held outcome metric is computed
causality.held_outcomes: metrics only; never an input to prediction
